title: A binary save file
description:
Games and tools store data in binary formats of their own. Design-and-build time: write players to a binary file in a fixed format, read the file back, show its bytes, and decode it again.

The input is one player per line: `name score level`, for example `Ada 1200 7`.

**The file format** (`save.bin`), every number little-endian:

| Bytes | Holds |
|---|---|
| 4 | the magic text `XSAV`, so readers can tell it is the right kind of file |
| 1 | the format version: 1 |
| 2 | the number of players (`uint16_t`) |
| then, for each player: | |
| 1 | the name's length, 1 to 20 |
| length | the name's characters, with no terminator |
| 4 | the score (`uint32_t`) |
| 1 | the level (`uint8_t`) |

**The program**

1. Reads the players. A line that is not a name of 1 to 20 characters, a score from 0 to 4294967295 and a level from 0 to 255 prints `Skipped: ` and the line, and is left out. At most 1000 players.
2. Writes `save.bin` with `fwrite` and closes it.
3. Opens it again, reads the whole file into memory with `fread`, and prints `save.bin: N bytes` and a hex dump in the same format as the hex dump practice task (16 bytes per line, offset, bytes, `|characters|`, but **no** total line at the end).
4. Decodes those bytes, checking the magic and version (print `Not a save file` and stop if they are wrong), and prints each player as `NAME: score SCORE, level LEVEL`.

For

```
Ada 1200 7
Grace 4000000000 255
```

the output is

```
save.bin: 27 bytes
00000000  58 53 41 56 01 02 00 03 41 64 61 b0 04 00 00 07  |XSAV....Ada.....|
00000010  05 47 72 61 63 65 00 28 6b ee ff                 |.Grace.(k..|
Ada: score 1200, level 7
Grace: score 4000000000, level 255
```
requirements: Write helper functions that put and get 16- and 32-bit little-endian numbers with shifts.
Build the whole file in a byte buffer, write it with one `fwrite`, and read it back with `fread`.
Decode from the bytes read back, not from the players you parsed.
Check every `fopen`, and close every file.

Linus 1100 3
nobody
Ken -5 2
Dennis 10 256
Bjarne 4294967296 1

Ada 1 1 extra

00000010  00 03 07 42 61 72 62 61 72 61 ff ff ff ff 00     |...Barbara.....|

Barbara: score 4294967295, level 0
